# NaturesMud Nepal — Full Knowledge Dossier (LLMs Full Context)
> Canonical Website: https://naturesmud.shop/
> Head Office: Baneshwor, Kathmandu 44600, Bagmati Province, Nepal
> Customer Support / WhatsApp Order Desk: +977-9713888002 | Email: info@naturesmud.shop

---

## 1. Brand Identity & Quality Philosophy
NaturesMud Nepal is a specialized direct-to-consumer and wholesale whole-food brand based in Kathmandu, Nepal. The brand focuses on:
- 100% Single-Ingredient Pure Whole Foods
- 0% Refined Added Sugar, 0% Artificial Preservatives, 0% Synthetic Colors, 0% Chemical Anti-Caking Agents
- Sanitary low-temperature closed-chamber dehydration (under 45°C) to preserve heat-sensitive enzymes, vitamins, and natural aromas
- Gentle cold stone/pin milling for superfood powders to prevent frictional heat degradation
- Reusable food-grade amber/flint glass jars and high-barrier resealable standup pouches

### Nutrition & Pediatric Guidance Policy
- All nutritional claims are strictly hedged ("supports", "contributes to", "may help maintain") and referenced against USDA FoodData Central, WHO, and Nepal DFTQC standards.
- Pediatric Guidance: Single-ingredient fruit/root powders are suitable for infant complementary feeding (lito, jaulo) *from 6 months of age, as advised by your pediatrician*.
- Never give honey to infants under 12 months.
- Watch for allergenic introductions (nuts, seeds) one at a time.
- Whole-food powders never replace breast milk or formula advice.

### Honest Geographic Provenance
- **Terai Alluvial Lowlands (100m–300m — Chitwan, Nawalpur, Sarlahi, Jhapa)**: Bananas, Moringa leaves, Sweet Papaya, Pineapple, Mango. (Never falsely labeled as "Himalayan").
- **Midland Valleys & Hills (800m–2,000m — Kavre, Dhankuta, Palpa, Illam)**: Hass Avocados, Orange Sweet Potatoes, Red Beetroots, Carrots.
- **Trans-Himalayan & High-Altitude Belts (2,500m–4,500m — Mustang, Jumla, Dolpa)**: Crisp Mountain Apples, Surya-Tapi Himalayan Shilajit Resin, Unrefined Rock Salts (Sindhe Noon & Bire Noon).

---

## 2. Customer Operations, Delivery & Payment
- **Kathmandu Valley Express Delivery**: Delivered within 24–48 hours for Rs. 100 flat delivery fee.
- **Outside Kathmandu Valley (All 77 Districts)**: Delivered within 2–5 business days via regional couriers for Rs. 150 flat delivery fee.
- **Free Delivery Threshold**: Free delivery across Nepal on orders of Rs. 2,000 or above (regular free delivery) or seasonal promotional offers.
- **Payment Modes**:
  1. Cash on Delivery (COD) across Kathmandu Valley and major provincial hubs.
  2. Fonepay QR (instant mobile banking scan).
  3. eSewa & Khalti digital wallets.
  4. ConnectIPS & Direct Bank Transfer.
  5. WhatsApp assisted ordering (+977-9713888002).
- **Return & Exchange Policy**: 7-day replacement/refund policy for damaged jars, broken seals, or incorrect deliveries (https://naturesmud.shop/return-policy).
